title: Move Zeroes
summary: Shift every zero to the end while keeping the other values in order.
statement:
Move every `0` in `nums` to the end of the array, keeping the relative order of the non-zero values unchanged.

Return the resulting array.

### Constraints

- 0 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10,000
- -10⁹ ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10⁹

visibleTests.explanation: Non-zeroes keep their order; two zeroes go to the back.

solutions.python:
def move_zeroes(nums):
    out = [n for n in nums if n != 0]
    out.extend([0] * (len(nums) - len(out)))
    return out
